blockers_for_one_core_injection: There is no single shared system-prompt surface: 6 distinct composer families (prompt_style_blocks.compose_verbalizer_system, direct_chat_service legacy tail, summary_generator, factcheck_service, search_service/web/youtube, checkup_service) each build their own system message.

15+ independent 'toxic/cynical/sarcastic' canon copies live in separate modules (chat/checkup/factcheck/search/summary/web/youtube/lore/nostalgia + smartmodule_phrases.CHAT_PERSONA_PHRASE) - only prompt_style_blocks.STYLE_BLOCKS_SUFFIX is shared, and only by the rebuttal canons.

Non-catalog prompt constants (dream_prompts, lore_prompts, nostalgia_prompts, dossier_prompts, smartmodule_phrases, ORCHESTRATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT) are not PG-editable and have no prompts.* key - a Core that only edits the catalog is invisible to them.
Persisted genuinely-custom PG values (at least the 6 summary keys) override the code canon: injecting a Core by editing canon constants or a defaults-migration changes nothing on production.
Direct turn renders owner identity TWICE (legacy system prompt tail + verbalizer character_block) - a Core appended to only one place creates contradictory instructions in the same request.
Initiative and L1 do not read prompts.direct_chat_system_prompt at all - a Core injected there never reaches the initiative path or the L1 decision layer.

Kill-switch branches (SMART_VERBALIZER_MODES_ENABLED=OFF, persona gate OFF, character_layers OFF, response_plan_enabled OFF) silently replace the whole style surface - a Core must define its behaviour for each branch or it is bypassed.
Kill-switch/fallback branches emit no counter/warning on the hot_config fallback path (resolve_prompt), so a 'Core is active' claim cannot be verified from telemetry today.
